title: Every QA review needs a comment
description: Passing QA used to be one click, so a passed task kept no record of what the reviewer checked. Passing now asks what you checked, the same way sending work back asks what needs changing.
items: Applies to Pass QA on client work and Pass QA and close on internal work
On internal work, any move out of review needs a comment, except putting it back in the QA queue
A task can no longer be dragged out of review on the board. Use the task's buttons or the status menu, which ask for the comment
pending: Needs the P16-08 database update applied before the database enforces it.
